coreIdeas.mentalMove: A reader learns to test the premise behind a strategy before debating execution, price, or effort.
coreIdeas.name: assumption risk
coreIdeas.oneSentence: Decisions begin from what people think they know; weak assumptions can make competent action point at the wrong problem.

coreIdeas.mentalMove: A reader learns why a spike in sales or attention is not the same as belief-driven preference.
coreIdeas.name: manipulation versus inspiration
coreIdeas.oneSentence: Price cuts, fear, novelty, peer pressure, and promotions can trigger behavior without creating durable loyalty.

coreIdeas.mentalMove: A reader learns to make purpose the organizing center before proof points and products.
coreIdeas.name: Golden Circle
coreIdeas.oneSentence: Influential communication moves from WHY to HOW to WHAT rather than listing features first.

coreIdeas.mentalMove: A reader learns why facts can be accurate yet fail to move a decision when they do not connect to felt value.
coreIdeas.name: biological decision language
coreIdeas.oneSentence: The model maps WHAT language to analytical processing and WHY language to feeling, trust, and choice.

coreIdeas.mentalMove: A reader learns that purpose becomes credible only when choices, offers, and language line up over time.
coreIdeas.name: alignment discipline
coreIdeas.oneSentence: A clear WHY needs disciplined HOWs and consistent WHATs so outsiders can recognize the same belief in repeated behavior.
